title: first-users-hunter signal record
description: One line of <run>/signals.jsonl: a dated public act by one person, as a collector returned it. Every collector (scripts/collectors/*.py) writes this shape, the founder's manual CSV included. The text is verbatim; collect.py caches it under cache/<hash>.txt for the signal URL so verify_people.py can check excerpts against it. Validated with shared/scripts/validate_json.py.

signal_id.description: <collector>:<id at the source>, unique in the run.

network.description: Where the person acted. community: a closed group read from founder screenshots or pasted text.

handle.description: Author handle on that network, lower case; empty for registry rows and lists without a handle.

thread_url.description: The discussion the signal sits in, read in full before drafting.

text.description: Verbatim words of the person, original language.

date_source.description: api: date field of the source API; post_id: decoded from a LinkedIn or X id in the URL; page: read on the page; registry: public registry; founder: given by the founder (screenshots of a closed group).

authored.description: true when the person wrote or hosted it (it then counts as one own post); false for registry rows, lists and third-party mentions.

community.description: Where it was said: Ask HN, r/<sub>, <owner>/<repo>, a Luma calendar, a list name.

links.description: Other handles the source itself publishes for this person (a Luma host profile, a list column). Used to merge identities, never guessed.
